items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks often strike the right balance between having proven business models and market opportunities that can support $100 billion corporations. However, they face intense competition from scaled industry giants and can be disrupted by new innovative players vying for a slice of the pie.

items.title: Aerospace Stocks Q2 In Review: Textron (NYSE:TXT) Vs Peers
items.summary: The end of an earnings season can be a great time to discover new stocks and assess how companies are handling the current business environment. Let’s take a look at how Textron (NYSE:TXT) and the rest of the aerospace stocks fared in Q2.

items.title: Can GE Aerospace Boost Profit Margin Amid Cost Pressures?
items.summary: GE targets stronger margins through cost control and backlog conversion as inflation and growth investments pressure profitability.

items.title: Why Is Textron (TXT) Down 2.7% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: Textron (TXT) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: Is Textron Benefiting from the Growing Demand for Light Jets?
items.summary: TXT's 500th Citation CJ4 delivery and upcoming CJ4 Gen3 highlight its push to capture demand for efficient, versatile light business jets.

items.title: Boston Whaler parent Brunswick bets on AI self-docking boats, Textron defense deal to power growth
items.summary: Brunswick CEO David Foulkes is looking past a soft new-boat market to autonomy, AI, and defense, including an unmanned military vessel built with Textron, as the next drivers of growth for the world's largest recreational boat company.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Textron Stock?
items.summary: Textron stock has underperformed the broader market over the past year, while analysts remain moderately bullish about its prospects.

items.title: This boating company wants to make docking less stressful with autonomous tech
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian sits down with Brunswick chairman and CEO David Foulkes to discuss the boat manufacturer's latest technology it is demonstrating in the Brooklyn Bridge Marina, including autonomous docking features.
